title: Fake Property Control Hub
features:
This script creates a simple hub that allows you to fake properties like WalkSpeed and JumpPower on your Roblox character. It uses the Orion Library for a user-friendly interface, with toggles and textboxes to enable or modify fake values. Designed as a client-side script, it only works if the anti-cheat checks property values like WalkSpeed directly, without advanced function hooks. A test environment is included to demonstrate functionality.

And the test environment is
https://www.roblox.com/games/130999049368928/SecureRemoteEvent
